plan.notes: Sequence transcribed from the official Program Guide PDF (Program Guide link on the official program page, anokatech.edu/programs/welding/; retrieved 2026-10-01 via the atc-website-test.azurewebsites.net staging mirror, which serves the same CMS media asset as anokatech.edu). The PDF template header prints '2023-2024'; the guide is the currently published program guide and its program name, sequence, and 17-credit total match the current official programs listing (Welding Fabricator Certificate, 17 credits). Admission requires successful completion of the Welding Technology Diploma or admission to the Welding AAS Degree program. Students must earn a cumulative 2.0 GPA or higher to be eligible for graduation. Program starts Fall (August). This program requires students to go full-time; students are required to take all courses. Prepares students for national certification examinations: American Society of Mechanical Engineers, American Petroleum Institute, American Welding Society's Welding Code.
